author: TragikBolt
body:
Dear Minecraft,

Hello Minecraft. This is Sean's mother. I have seen what he has done on Minecraft. I have given him a huge lecture about respect. I have also grounded him for 3 months. I realize what he said was highly unacceptable and just plain rude. He and his younger brother Jamal use this account to play. Jamal really is bummed because he now can not play on this server due to Sean's disrespect. I will promise you that Sean can no longer access this account. Can you please take away the permanent ban put on this account. I wouldn't to disappoint Jamal as he is civilized on Minecraft.

Regards,
Ayesha

replies.body:
Hello,


With all due respect, many other users have been banned for the same reason, yet their punishment has remained valid. The infraction will not be appealed, as this account clearly did break rules. 


Thanks!
